note: v1 94.67 (seeds 0/11 94.67/94.59), Glass Arithmetic: math rock with mallets at 150 bpm. Every bar an additive grouping of 2s and 3s (5-13 eighths); kick and bass on each group start, snare on the last. A 5-note tapped loop (starcaster-clean, sixteenths) and a 7-note loop (clean-dry, eighths) braid across the bar lines; hats in dotted eighths; the marimba tune walks the chord. Half-time B, a 3+2 breakdown, a build that grows by one 3 a bar, the last return a whole step up. Drafts: 82.66 (flat dynamics, all on the eighth grid) -> 87.85 (dynamics lane, EQ to the genre envelope) -> 89.84 (dotted hats) -> 94.67.
